description: For every actual original equality-clause set \(\Delta\), a nonempty original clause model exists if and only if the actual shared relation-clause set \(\Delta^E\cup\mathcal E_L\) has a nonempty clause model.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EqualityAxioms.originalClauses_equisatisfiable.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  (Δ : Set (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EqualityAxioms.OriginalClause L ℕ)) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EqualityAxioms.OriginalClauseSatisfiable Δ ↔
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.ClauseSatisfiable
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EqualityAxioms.translatedClauses Δ ∪
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EqualityAxioms.axiomClauses L)
